"The Phantom Menace" is a 1999 film that introduces the young Anakin Skywalker, who lives on the desert planet Tatooine in a galaxy far, far away. The movie follows his journey as he becomes involved with the Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn and his apprentice Obi-Wan Kenobi, who are on a mission to protect Queen Padmé Amidala of Naboo from the Trade Federation's invasion. Along the way, Anakin is discovered to be exceptionally strong in the Force, and Qui-Gon believes he should be trained as a Jedi. Anakin does not learn the ways of the Force from Yoda on Dagobah; that happens much later in the series. Instead, he is introduced to Yoda on the Jedi Temple planet of Coruscant. The film also features the Sith Lord Darth Maul, who is the apprentice of Darth Sidious (later revealed to be Senator Palpatine). The fate of Queen Amidala and her people is indeed at stake, and Senator Palpatine does seek to gain control of the Senate, but his manipulation and deceit are not the central focus of the film. The movie concludes with a climactic battle between the Jedi and Darth Maul, and the resolution of the conflict on Naboo.
